description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called ProfileScreen, which displays a user profile interface including user info, statistics, settings, support options, and actions. It references external widgets and screens such as EditProfileScreen, and contains internal classes for UI components like _StatPill and _SettingTile.

classes.name: ProfileScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the profile page of the app, including user info, stats, settings, support, and sign-out button.

classes.name: _ColorKey
classes.description: An enum used internally to specify color roles for styling the statistics pill widgets.

classes.name: _StatPill
classes.description: A custom StatelessWidget that displays a labeled value with background color based on the given color key.

classes.name: _SettingTile
classes.description: A custom ListTile widget used for settings and support options with icon, title, subtitle, and tap callback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the ProfileScreen widget UI, constructing various sections including user info, stats, settings, support, and sign-out button.

methods.name: _notify
methods.description: Displays a SnackBar with a message, used as a placeholder for navigation or other actions.

methods.name: _resolveColor
methods.description: Helps _StatPill determine its background color based on the _ColorKey enum.
